cat > view-2.puml <<'EOF'
@startuml view-2
title View 2 - makeReservation runtime flow (where rules are applied)
actor Student
participant "ReservationController /\nSwing ReservationSummary" as UI
participant LibraryFacade as F
participant ReservationManager as RM
participant StudyRoomRegistry as SRR
participant UserRegistry as UR
participant "Student / Area / Seat\n(entities)" as E
participant AssignmentStrategy as AS
participant ReservationRegistry as RR
database MySQL as DB
participant Reservation as R
participant NotificationManager as NM
participant NotificationServiceAdapter as AD
participant ExternalEmailGateway as GW

Student -> UI : choose room, slot, area, seat (0 = auto)
UI -> F : makeReservation(ReservationRequestDTO)
F -> RM : makeReservation(request)
RM -> UR : findStudentById
RM -> SRR : findRoomById (active? open on weekday?)
RM -> SRR : findAreaById (area belongs to room?)
RM -> RM : resolveTimeSlot (not past / not started)
RM -> SRR : validateSeatInArea (seat in area?)
group synchronized(this)  - rule checks + availability
  RM -> E : student.hasActiveOrConfirmedReservationForDateAndSlot()
  E -> RR : findActiveReservations
  RR -> DB
  RM -> E : area.getAvailableSeats(date, slot)
  E -> RR : seat.isAvailable -> findReservationsBySeat
  RR -> DB
  alt seatId == 0
    RM -> AS : selectSeat(available)
  else specific seat
    RM -> E : seat.isAvailable (re-check)
  end
  RM -> R : new Reservation, setState(ActiveState)
  RM -> RR : saveReservation
  RR -> DB : INSERT via PersistenceManager
  RM -> R : attach(NotificationManager); notifyObservers()
  R -> NM : update(reservation)
  NM -> AD : sendNotification(recipients, message)
  AD -> GW : send(email, subject, body)
  note right: failure is caught and logged;\nbooking is not rolled back
end
RM --> F : ReservationDTO
F --> UI
UI --> Student

== Background (every 60 s, NotificationScheduler) ==
F <- UI : manageReservationEnd() / sendReminders()
note over RM, NM : ACTIVE past 10-min tolerance -> EXPIRED;\nCONFIRMED past slot end -> COMPLETED;\nstate change notifies the student
@enduml
EOF
cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# Seat booking architecture (IS-seat-L3)

Layers: Boundary (Swing UI, REST controllers, scheduler, e-mail adapter) -> Controller (LibraryFacade, managers) -> Entity (domain + registries) -> PersistenceManager (JPA) -> MySQL.

- **view-1.puml - component view.** Shows the components in the booking process and their dependencies:
  - Request handling: Swing wizard, Web UI, `ReservationController`, `StudyRoomController` and `LibraryFacade`.
  - Booking rules and availability: `ReservationManager`, `StudyRoomManager`, `Student`, `StudyRoom`, `Area`, `Seat`, `AssignmentStrategy`.
  - Reservation storage: `Reservation` (state pattern), `ReservationRegistry`, `PersistenceManager`.
  - Notifications: `NotificationManager` -> `NotificationService` -> `NotificationServiceAdapter` -> `ExternalEmailGateway`, plus the scheduler.
  
  Use it to see which components a rule change touches and what else depends on them.
- **view-2.puml - sequence view of `makeReservation`.** Shows the order of the validations, the availability check, seat assignment, persistence and notification. It marks the `synchronized` block where uniqueness and availability are checked together. It also shows that a notification failure doesn't roll back the booking. The background expiry and reminder job is included at the end.

Observations from the code:
- New rules most naturally go into the `makeReservation` validation chain in `ReservationManager`. Rules that depend on stored data need new queries in `ReservationRegistry`.
- `cancelReservation` and `performCheckIn` have their own rules in `Reservation`: a 6-hour cancellation window and a 10-minute check-in tolerance.
- Seat availability is defined in `Seat.isAvailable` and `ReservationRegistry.occupiesSlot`. `StudyRoomManager` (seat map) and the statistics code reuse these, so changes there affect them too.
- Changing the states in `Reservation` affects `NotificationManager.messageForState`, which switches over every state.
- The e-mail gateway is a stub that always returns 200.
EOF
(plantuml -checkonly view-*.puml 2>&1 || true) | head

The README has the same notes and says why each view exists.
